Assignment 6
Q.1 Write a C++ program to compute the FIRST set of a given context-free grammar.
Input:
Number of productions: 4
E=TR
R=+TR
R=#
T=i
Expected Output:
FIRST(E) = { i }
FIRST(R) = { +, # }
FIRST(T) = { i }
Q.2 Write a C++ program to compute the FOLLOW set for all non-terminals of a given 
grammar.
Input:
Number of productions: 3
S=AB
A=aA
A=#
B=b
Expected Output:
FOLLOW(S) = { $ }
FOLLOW(A) = { b }
FOLLOW(B) = { $ }
